votes.motion: Approve the Special Town Meeting warrant with the caveat that the errant recommendation line be removed from ARTICLE 4.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to approve the warrant with the caveat that the errant recommendation line be removed from article 4. ms. bertram seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Appoint Brian LeBlanc as the RACES Operator.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to appoint brian leblanc as the races operator. mr. alonzo seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Appoint Dave Matthews as the Representative to the School Negotiating Sub-Committee.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to appoint dave matthews as the representative to the school negotiating sub-committee. mr. alonzo seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Extend the appointment of Myleen Mallari as acting Treasurer/Collector through 09/11/12.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to extend the appointment of myleen mallari, as acting treasurer/collector through 09/11/12. ms. bertram seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Enter Executive Session, not to return, per MGL to negotiate or strategize for negotiations.
votes.quote: executive session - mr. matthews moved to go into executive session, not to return, per mgl to negotiate or strategize for negotiations. ms. bertram seconded.
the board voted unanimously to adjourn regular session at 7:27pm.
